extracted.name: 2-Minute Cheese Quesadillas
extracted.description: Make a cheese quesadilla in the microwave with flour tortillas and shredded Cheddar cheese for a quick and easy snack every kid will love!
instruction_lines: Place one flour tortilla onto a large microwave-safe plate.
Sprinkle with Cheddar, then top with remaining tortilla.
Microwave on high until cheese is melted, about 1 minute. Slice like a pizza to serve.
